concepts.gloss_en: all the remedies/cures (the noun concept itself)

members.note: the bare noun-phrase concept 'all the remedies'

concepts.gloss_en: the falling/descent of all the remedies (an event/state predicated of the remedies, not the remedies themselves)

members.note: verbal predication 'all the remedies fall' — an action about the remedies, distinct from the noun per rule 4

concepts.gloss_en: the receiving of all the remedies (an action of reception, distinct from both the remedies and their falling)

members.note: verbal predication 'that all the remedies are received' — a different action from 'falling'; kept separate per rule 4

notes: Token-overlap on 'כל הרפואות' is misleading. Only one form is the noun concept; the other two are distinct verbal predications (falling vs. receiving) about the remedies. Per rule 4, actions/states about X are not X, and the two actions differ from each other. No merge.
